messages:
maria-rt: FYI after last night's continuous-batching tweak we're seeing p99 go from ~120ms to ~420ms and token throughput down ~18% in region-us-central.

jake-ml: noted. which flags shipped? token_budget / queue_wait changes?

maria-rt: token_budget_target 1024->2048, max_queue_wait_ms 12->35. Deployed 2024-11-27T02:14:00Z.

sara-sre: any kernel_selector changes? I want to rule out kernel routing shifts.

maria-rt: yes, kernel_selector now biases to long-kernel at avg_seq >= 480 (was 640) to avoid mid-request swaps.

perf-bot: [metric] p99_latency_ms service/inference (region-us-central) spike 118 -> 422 between 1732819024 and 1732823200 :eyes:

jake-ml: hypothesis: larger token budgets + longer wait allow mixed-size batches. With lower long-kernel threshold some batches go to long kernel which is expensive for short seqs -> tail latency.

lina-eng: replayed prod traces locally for 30m with new heuristic. saw repeated kernel init stalls in mixed batches. snippet:
```
batch_id=1203 sizes=[1,4,1,8,2]
avg_seq=323 token_budget_used=1987
kernel_chosen=long_v2
kv_cache_hit_rate=0.18
```
stall ~250ms on kernel init.

sara-sre: kv_cache_hit_rate 18% is low. any eviction or preload changes?

maria-rt: no eviction change. Larger batches increase working set diversity -> more KV misses.

jake-ml: profiler flames show long_kernel layout_setup and kv_prefetch dominating when it runs. top lines:
```
long_kernel(layout_setup): 34%
kv_prefetch/miss: 21%
attention_kernel: 18%
memcpy(H->D): 12%
io_wait: 6%
```

lina-eng: also saw enqueue variance climb as the queue waits for bigger batches. That reduces throughput while increasing tail.

sara-sre: proposed repro + mitigation: (1) canary rollback token_budget_target to 1024 and max_queue_wait_ms to 12; (2) restore long_seq_threshold to 640; (3) run A/B 2h capturing p50/p95/p99, kv_hit_rate, kernel_switch_count.

maria-rt: deploying canary now with patch:
```
continuous_batching:
  token_budget_target: 1024
  max_queue_wait_ms: 12
kernel_selector:
  long_seq_threshold: 640
```

perf-bot: [action] canary canary-rt-3 started @ 1732820400

jake-ml: while canary runs add a short-term guard: if kv_cache_hit_rate < 0.3 and batch_mixed then prefer short_kernels to avoid paying long_kernel layout/setup cost. quick pseudo:
```
if batch_mixed and kv_cache_hit_rate < 0.3:
  prefer_kernel = short_v2
```

lina-eng: agree. also instrument kernel_switches_per_min metric and emit batch_mixed tag so we can analyze tail patterns.

maria-rt: canary update after 45m: p99 down to ~130ms, throughput back +2% vs baseline. kv_hit_rate roughly flat. kernel_switch storms gone.

sara-sre: good. keep canary 2h then promote if stable. follow-up: we need focused microbench for mixed seq distributions and kv miss patterns.

maria-rt: creating ticket PERF-rt-587 "mixed-batch kernel selection matrix + KV miss simulation" assign @jake-ml @lina-eng.

jake-ml: I'll run synthetic loads with varied seq dist and compile tuned layout_setup.

lina-eng: add a short-term alert: if p99 > 250ms AND kernel_switch_rate > 20/min -> auto rollback batching flags.

maria-rt: agreed. thanks team. leaving thread open for graphs and canary logs. :thumbsup:
